newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek broker Devletoglou says in full compliance.
newsitem.headline: Greek broker Devletoglou says in full compliance.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member N. Devletoglou Securities, one of the bourse's largest brokers, said in a statement it was in full compliance on all its trades both vis-a-vis the exchange and its clients.
"Following several press reports in the last few days related to the bourse's current upset, N. Devletoglou states categorically that it is in full compliance on all its trades," it said.
The brokerage said all its clients' securities and credit cash balances were available at any moment.
"We thank all our clients -- retail and institutional -- for the trust they have shown to our firm," N. Devletoglou said.
N. Devletoglou issued the statement to the media after the bourse supervisor George Malakis ordered an audit of the firm, along with nine other companies.

Most members of the Athens brokers association (SMEHA) have refrained from trading for the last three days, effectively closing the exchange. They took the action after one firm, Delta Securities, was charged with fraud last week.
Delta is accused to trying to pay 2.6 billion drachmas of settlements with bad cheques.

SMEHA members have demanded that the government take action to make sure the bourse clearing house functions properly in the future and that settlements are guaranteed. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
